python_initial.setup_cause: Isolated source copy had no independent Git index required by export_core; corrected in the copy only.
python_initial.transient_root_cause: not established; do not infer antivirus, filesystem or concurrency cause without additional evidence

node_final.scope: Native Chat and Workbench logic/contract tests, including VM and fake DOM; not complete IDE E2E
node_final.initial_setup_note: First attempt used incorrect cwd and a dependency-free copy; ENOENT and MODULE_NOT_FOUND corrected by running read-only tests at project root with existing dependencies.

flow_structure.scope: Structure, local slots, subflow dependencies and component interfaces only

http_smoke.scope: Fresh API source export, temporary loopback port, temporary built Workbench; no main startup, no durable worker, no real model call

controlled_reproductions.observation: Explicit parent chat policy became agent policy in a thread branch; different policy object, no parent context and no approval callback.
Synthetic environment value rendered by Knowledge and remained unredacted with an empty SecretView allowlist.
Global dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY replaced an explicit dummy key and was selected for a custom audit.invalid endpoint header; no HTTP request made.
Drive-qualified ZIP member wrote a marker outside the simulated installation root, entirely within audit tmp.
controlled_reproductions.precondition: User imports a controlled or malformed local update ZIP; not a no-interaction remote exploit.

controlled_reproductions.observation: require_signature=True accepted a dummy signed package without a trusted signing key, returning present-unverified; package was not installed.
Non-cooperative callable wrote a temporary marker after NodeTimeout was raised; this does not negate separate Process-node process-tree termination.
Default false prompt inclusion setting did not remove a synthetic prompt from a synthetic log ZIP; system diagnostics probe mocked, no actual logs read or uploaded.

additional_static_findings: Default Legacy Evolution evaluates Identity text rather than the selected Harness and modified capabilities.
V2 structural product path imports experiments and commits candidates from simulated failure information without real task benefit gate.
Data node persistent actions are not classified as side_effecting for inflight checkpoints.
remove_node_and_bypass rewrites parent edges outside a narrowly declared mutation surface.
Session and trajectory loading lack stale-response protection.
File-filter bulk accept ignores per-change failure.
Background handoff can classify a file exceeding the size limit as deleted.
Whole-conversation positive training projection can contain locally down-rated assistant content.
Think-tag filtering lacks cross-delta tag buffering.
Parallel fail_fast waits for branch completion and budget accounting is aggregated after execution.
Knowledge catalog accepts formats not accepted by the activation loader.
Legacy Evolution retains independent provider credential fallback outside the common connection resolver.
